Key-based UI strings with locale switching and {name} interpolation, served by the i18n feature (praisonaiui.features.i18n). English, Spanish and French ship built in.

The i18n system uses a key-based translation approach: Each string has a dotted key (e.g., app.welcome, chat.send) Keys are grouped by prefix: app, chat, skills, finops, nav, error {name} placeholders are replaced at lookup time An unknown key returns the key itself; an unknown locale falls back to English
Locale Language Strings en English 36 es Spanish (Español) 36 fr French (Français) 36
A different backend implements I18nProtocol (t, list_locales, get_strings, get_locale, set_locale) and is installed with set_i18n_manager().

The React styles read a YAML i18n block. With more than one locale, the header shows a locale switcher; picking a locale loads its strings from /api/i18n/strings/{locale} and sets the server locale. A locale in rtlLocales switches the page to right-to-left.

Endpoint Method Description /api/i18n/locales GET List available locales /api/i18n/strings/{locale} GET Get all strings for a locale /api/i18n/translate POST Translate a key with optional variables /api/i18n/locale GET Get current default locale /api/i18n/locale POST Set default locale
An unknown locale returns 404; a malformed one 400.
